title: Je remerchi dieu (Martini)
desc: Johannes Martini, Je remerchi dieu. 3 voices (Cantus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Mar3014); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
